# 📱 App Icon V1 — Bottle Hero

**Amaç**: App Store / Play Store app icon, varyasyon 1.

**Boyut**: 1024×1024 (App Store), 512×512 (Play Store), all platform sizes auto-generated.

**Konsept**: Single dramatic glass bottle hero shot. Shows the core game asset.

---

## Sora / ChatGPT / Midjourney Prompt

```
App icon design for POURLE casual mobile puzzle game, square 1024×1024,
smooth 3D toon render Royal Match style. Designed for App Store / Play
Store thumbnail visibility.

Composition: Single iconic glass apothecary bottle, centered, taking up
~75% of icon area. Bottle filled with 4 colored liquid layers — each a
different vibrant element color creating a satisfying visual gradient:
- Bottom layer: Fire red #E63946 with letter "B" in white bold serif
- Layer 2: Water blue #1D7DBF with letter "R"
- Layer 3: Earth green #5C8A3C with letter "E"
- Top layer: Air gold #F4D35E with letter "W"
Letters spell "BREW" reading bottom-to-top.

Bottle glass: Clear toon-style glass with subtle 3D refraction, slight
gold cork at top, narrow neck flaring to wider body. Soft white highlight
shine on left edge of bottle (3D toon polish).

Around bottle: Subtle golden halo glow radiating outward (peak moment
hint), 4-6 small golden particles floating around bottle (magical
sparkle), slot-machine satisfaction energy.

Background: Warm gradient — cream #F5E8D0 in upper, transitioning to
soft amber #D4B87A in lower, with subtle radial vignette focusing on
bottle.

Border / framing: Optional subtle warm wood-tone curved corner radius
indicator (iOS standard rounded square auto-applied by store).

Style: Royal Match smooth 3D toon render. MUST be visually punchy at
small sizes (1x scale ~60×60 px on phone home screen). High contrast
between liquid layers, letters bold readable at 60×60 px scale.

Color palette:
- Primary: Cream #F5E8D0, amber #D4B87A
- Liquid: Fire red, water blue, earth green, air gold
- Letters: White or slightly off-white for readability
- Glow: Gold #D4B87A, cream highlight

NEVER include:
- Multiple bottles (icon must be ONE clear focal point).
- Tiny details that don't read at 60×60 px.
- Text "POURLE" in icon (separate logo handled by store listing).
- Painterly style.
- Aggressive monetization indicators.
- Anime/chibi exaggeration.
- Gothic dark atmosphere.

Format: 1024×1024 square, ultra-sharp, perfect for App Store icon
guidelines (no text overlay, focal subject 75% area, high contrast).
```

---

## Test Methodology

### Small-size readability test
- Mockup'ı 60×60 px, 90×90 px, 120×120 px scale
- En küçük scale'de letterler okunaklı mı?
- Bottle silhouette tanınır mı?

### A/B test plan
- Soft launch'ta 3 icon variant test (V1, V2, V3)
- Apple Search Ads creative split test
- Conversion rate tracking — en yüksek install rate kazanır
